findings.summary_cve: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor that opens a root shell on port 6200 when a username ending in ':)' is supplied.
findings.fix: Upgrade vsftpd to a vendor-supported release (3.x) or migrate to SFTP. Verify package integrity against official repositories.

findings.summary_cve: OpenSSL Heartbleed: the TLS heartbeat extension leaks up to 64KB of process memory per request.
findings.impact: Disclosure of private keys, session tokens, and credentials.
findings.fix: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g+, reissue certificates, and rotate any secrets that may have been exposed.

findings.summary_cve: Apache httpd mod_mime can read one byte past the end of a buffer when handling a malicious Content-Type response header.
findings.impact: Information disclosure / potential denial of service.
findings.fix: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.2.33, 2.4.26, or later.
